title: Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans, 2nd edition
publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Disease Prevention and Health Promotion
claims: Adults gain substantial health benefits from regular physical activity.
The guidelines recommend moving more and sitting less throughout the day.

For substantial health benefits, adults need at least 150 to 300 minutes a week of moderate-intensity aerobic activity, or 75 to 150 minutes a week of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity, or an equivalent combination.
Adults should do muscle-strengthening activities on at least 2 days a week.
